description:
Module inside lernie-ui-dioxus that executes 'lernie <subcommand>' as a subprocess and streams stdout/stderr. Per ARCH §3.4 / §3.5, this is the sole command path from frontend to harness.

=== What to build ===

- Pure-Rust module, no Dioxus dependency.
- API: 'Cli::new(lernie_binary: PathBuf) -> Cli' and a method 'run(&self, args: &[&str]) -> impl Stream<Item = OutputChunk>' (or equivalent iter surface).
- Binary resolution: default is 'lernie' on PATH; overridable via env var 'LERNIE_BINARY' or explicit arg. Document both.
- stdout and stderr streamed chunked, tagged by stream.
- Exit status reported as a terminal item in the stream.
- Signal propagation: on drop, the child gets SIGTERM then SIGKILL after a short timeout (consistent with ARCH §2.9 'Stops are aggressive').

=== Out of scope ===

- Any knowledge of specific lernie subcommands (this is a generic exec wrapper).
- UI wiring — just the exec primitive.

=== Dependencies ===

- Blocks on 'UI skeleton'.

=== Testing ===

- Against a shell stub: a 'fake_lernie' executable on PATH for tests that emits known stdout/stderr patterns and exit codes. Not a mock — a real binary.
- Test signal-on-drop (spawn a long-running fake, drop the stream, assert the child is gone).
- 100% line coverage.
title: UI: CLI outbound module (exec lernie subcommand)
